data.title: 美狄亚 · 魔术师的海滨玻璃瓶
data.description: 【希腊风海湾·午后】美狄亚穿着紫蓝色泳装与轻便罩衫，坐在潮池旁把贝壳、海玻璃和海水装进小瓶；瓶中映出一枚微光魔法阵，她抬眼朝镜头微笑，像把海边的宁静也封存了。
data.action: 潮池旁把贝壳海玻璃装入小瓶，微光魔法阵映出整片海湾
data.lighting: soft afternoon light on clear tide pools
data.mood: 把假日变成精密小魔术
data.promptProse: Medea holds the bottle in one hand, lowering sea glass into it with the other. A faint magic circle glows in the seawater inside the bottle beside the sunlit tide pool.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the bottle while the other lowers sea glass into the faintly glowing seawater inside.
